translated_en: Adrien's total salary was 30% higher than Lylah's. Four years later, his salary had increased and was 40% higher than his initial salary. If Adrien and Lylah's salaries increased simultaneously, and Adrien earned $40,000 four years ago, calculate the total amount of their two salaries four years later.

question: Miguel utilise 2 cartons de papier par semaine pour son dessin. Si chaque carton contient 30 feuilles de papier, combien de feuilles de papier utilise-t-il par mois ?
translated_en: Miguel uses 2 boxes of paper per week for his drawing. If each box contains 30 sheets of paper, how many sheets of paper does he use per month?

question: Il a été demandé à Morisette et Kael d'apporter des fruits. Morisette a apporté 5 pommes et 8 oranges, tandis que Kael a apporté deux fois plus de pommes et la moitié moins d'oranges que Morisette. Combien de fruits ont-ils apporté en tout ?
translated_en: Morisette and Kael were asked to bring fruit. Morisette brought 5 apples and 8 oranges, while Kael brought twice as many apples and half as many oranges as Morisette. How much fruit did they bring in total?

question: Sadie a dormi 8 heures lundi. Elle a dormi 2 heures de moins chacun des deux jours qui ont suivi, à cause de certaines obligations. Sachant que le reste de la semaine elle a dormi 1 heure de plus que lors de ces deux jours, combien d'heures a-t-elle dormi au total durant toute la semaine ?
translated_en: Sadie slept 8 hours on Monday. She slept 2 hours less each of the following two days due to certain obligations. Knowing that she slept 1 hour more for the rest of the week than on those two days, how many hours did she sleep in total throughout the entire week?

question: Rosie court à une vitesse de 10 miles par heure pendant 3 heures. Ensuite, elle court 5 miles par heure. Combien de miles aura-t-elle parcouru en 7 heures ?
translated_en: Rosie runs at a speed of 10 miles per hour for 3 hours. Then she runs at 5 miles per hour. How many miles will she have run in 7 hours?

question: Jennie apporte une assistance au bureau de sa mère. Elle dispose d'une pile de 60 lettres à timbrer et d'une autre avec des lettres déjà timbrées. Elle tamponne un tiers des lettres à timbrer. S'il y a maintenant 30 lettres dans la pile de lettres timbrées, combien y en avait-il dans cette pile lorsque Jennie a commencé le travail ?
translated_en: Jennie is helping out at her mother's office. She has a stack of 60 letters to be stamped and another stack of letters that have already been stamped. She stamps one-third of the letters to be stamped. If there are now 30 letters in the stack of stamped letters, how many were in that stack when Jennie started the job?

question: Julia se préparait pour un dîner organisé chez elle, durant lequel elle comptait servir du ragoût. Elle a remarqué qu'elle n'avait plus de cuillères en plastique et a donc acheté un nouveau paquet de cuillères. Plus tard, son mari a également acheté un paquet de 5 nouvelles cuillères et les a données à Julia. Pendant la cuisson, Julia a utilisé trois cuillères pour goûter son ragoût. Plus tard, lorsqu'elle est allée mettre la table, elle avait un total de 12 cuillères. Combien de cuillères y avait-il dans le paquet que Julia a acheté ?
translated_en: Julia was preparing for a dinner party at her house, during which she planned to serve stew. She noticed she had run out of plastic spoons and so bought a new pack. Later, her husband also bought a pack of 5 new spoons and gave them to Julia. While the stew was cooking, Julia used three spoons to taste it. Later, when she went to set the table, she had a total of 12 spoons. How many spoons were in the pack Julia bought?

question: Dylan avait besoin de saucisses de poulet et de saucisses de poisson pour faire des petits pains aux saucisses lors d'une fête. Il a acheté 38 saucisses de poulet et 6 saucisses de poisson de plus qu'il n'y en avait de poulet. Combien de saucisses Dylan a-t-il achetées en tout ?
translated_en: Dylan needed chicken sausages and fish sausages to make sausage rolls for a party. He bought 38 more chicken sausages and 6 more fish sausages than there were chicken sausages. How many sausages did Dylan buy in total?

question: Après avoir été transférée dans une nouvelle école, Amy s'est fait 20 amies de plus que Lily. Si Lily s'est fait 50 amies, combien d'amies Lily et Amy ont-elles en tout ?
translated_en: After transferring to a new school, Amy made 20 more friends than Lily. If Lily made 50 friends, how many friends do Lily and Amy have in total?

question: La mère de Well vend des pastèques, des poivrons et des oranges au magasin du quartier. Une pastèque coûte trois fois plus cher qu'un poivron et une orange 5 fois moins qu'une pastèque. Dillon est envoyé au magasin pour acheter 4pastèques, 20 poivrons et 10 oranges. Quelle somme totale dépensera-t-il si chaque poivron coûte 15 $ ?
translated_en: Well's mother sells watermelons, peppers, and oranges at the neighborhood store. A watermelon costs three times more than a pepper, and an orange costs five times less than a watermelon. Dillon is sent to the store to buy 4 watermelons, 20 peppers, and 10 oranges. What is the total amount he will spend if each pepper costs $15?

question: Un hôpital admet 500 personnes par jour. Chaque patient est examiné en moyenne pendant 24 minutes. Les médecins facturent 150 $ par heure à l'hôpital et celui-ci 200 $ par heure aux patients. Combien de bénéfices l'hôpital réalise-t-il grâce à ces consultations ?
translated_en: A hospital admits 500 people per day. Each patient is examined for an average of 24 minutes. Doctors bill the hospital $150 per hour, and the hospital bills patients $200 per hour. How much profit does the hospital make from these consultations?

question: Nissa embauche 60 saisonniers pour jouer les lutins dans le village du Père Noël de son grand magasin. Un tiers des lutins démissionnent après que des enfants leur ont vomi dessus, puis 10 des lutins restants démissionnent après que des enfants leur ont donné des coups de pied dans le tibia. Combien de lutins reste-t-il ?
translated_en: Nissa hires 60 seasonal workers to play elves in the Santa's Village at her department store. A third of the elves quit after children vomit on them, then 10 of the remaining elves quit after children kick them in the shins. How many elves are left?

question: En mai, les dépenses de Joseph se sont élevées à 500 $. Elles ont baissé de 60 $ en juin. Quelle est la somme des dépenses effectuées durant les deux mois ?
translated_en: In May, Joseph's expenses totaled $500. They decreased by $60 in June. What was the total amount spent during the two months?

question: Pam et Fred sont allés à une fête foraine. Pam a fait 2 fois le tour des montagnes russes et Fred 4 fois. Ensuite, chacun d'eux a fait 2 fois de la luge. Si chaque tour coûte 6 tickets, combien ont-ils utilisé de tickets ce jour-là ?
translated_en: Pam and Fred went to a funfair. Pam went on the roller coaster twice and Fred went on it four times. Then, they each went on the toboggan run twice. If each ride costs 6 tickets, how many tickets did they use that day?

question: Lundi, Walt a marché 4 miles. Mardi, il a marché 6 fois plus de miles que le lundi. Son kilométrage de lundi à mercredi était de 41 miles. Combien de miles a-t-il parcouru mercredi ?
translated_en: On Monday, Walt walked 4 miles. On Tuesday, he walked 6 times as many miles as on Monday. His total mileage from Monday to Wednesday was 41 miles. How many miles did he walk on Wednesday?

question: Tom effectue 4 lavages de voiture par mois. Si chaque lavage coûte 15 dollars, combien dépense-t-il en un an ?
translated_en: Tom gets his car washed 4 times a month. If each wash costs $15, how much does he spend in a year?

question: L'ami de Brian, Bobby, possède 5 jeux vidéo de moins que 3 fois la quantité de jeux vidéo de Brian. Si Brian possède 20 jeux vidéo mais en a perdu 5 juste avant la comparaison du début, combien Bobby en possède-t-il ?
translated_en: Brian's friend, Bobby, owns 5 fewer video games than 3 times the number of video games Brian owns. If Brian owns 20 video games but lost 5 just before the initial comparison, how many does Bobby own?

question: Il ne reste que 27 licornes dans le monde. Un tiers d'entre elles se trouvent dans les Highlands, en Écosse. Deux tiers des licornes écossaises sont des femmes. Combien y a-t-il de licornes écossaises ?
translated_en: There are only 27 unicorns left in the world. A third of them live in the Scottish Highlands. Two-thirds of Scottish unicorns are female. How many Scottish unicorns are there?

question: Rory commande 2 sous-marins à 7,50 $ chacun, 2 paquets de frites à 1,50 $ chacun et 2 biscuits à 1,00 $ chacun. Des frais de livraison de 20 % sont facturés à la caisse et Rory ajoute un pourboire de 5,00 $. Quel sera le coût de sa commande de livraison ?
translated_en: Rory orders 2 subs at $7.50 each, 2 packages of fries at $1.50 each, and 2 cookies at $1.00 each. A 20% delivery fee is charged at the register, and Rory adds a $5.00 tip. What will be the cost of his delivery order?

question: Hier, Marc a passé un test de 75 questions. Il l'a passé à un rythme de 5 questions par heure. Aujourd'hui, il a passé un autre test de 100 questions au même rythme. Si Marc a pris 8 heures pour faire le premier test et 6 heures pour le deuxième, combien de questions sont restées sans réponse ?
translated_en: Yesterday, Marc took a 75-question test. He completed it at a rate of 5 questions per hour. Today, he took another 100-question test at the same rate. If Marc took 8 hours to complete the first test and 6 hours for the second, how many questions remained unanswered?

question: Dans un distributeur de bonbons, il y a 22 fois plus de boules de gommes bleues que quatre fois la quantité de boules de gommes roses. S'il y a 12 boules de gommes de bleues, combien y en a-t-il de roses ?
translated_en: In a candy dispenser, there are 22 times more blue gumballs than four times the amount of pink gumballs. If there are 12 blue gumballs, how many pink ones are there?

question: Parmi les 20 voitures de location disponibles, 12 sont des voitures automatiques, 4 des voitures manuelles et le reste des semi-automatiques. Quel est le pourcentage de voitures semi-automatiques ?
translated_en: Of the 20 rental cars available, 12 are automatic, 4 are manual, and the rest are semi-automatic. What percentage of the cars are semi-automatic?

question: Une ruche compte 700 abeilles. Il y a deux fois plus d'abeilles ouvrières que de bébés abeilles et deux fois plus de bébés que de reines. Combien d'abeilles ouvrières y a-t-il ?
translated_en: A beehive contains 700 bees. There are twice as many worker bees as baby bees, and twice as many baby bees as queens. How many worker bees are there?

question: Jordan passe 2 heures par jour à jouer à des jeux vidéo. Il occupe également un emploi à temps partiel qui lui rapporte 10 $ de l'heure. Combien d'argent Jordan gagnerait-il en une semaine, si son temps de jeu était consacré au travail ?
translated_en: Jordan spends 2 hours a day playing video games. He also has a part-time job that pays $10 an hour. How much money would Jordan earn in a week if his gaming time were spent working?

question: Jean achète pour 2 $ de lait, 3 $ d'œufs, 3 $ d'ampoules, 3 $ de tasses et 4 $ de pièges à cafards. Sachant qu'une taxe de 10 % s'applique à tous les articles non alimentaires, combien tout cela a-t-il coûté.
translated_en: Jean buys $2 worth of milk, $3 worth of eggs, $3 worth of light bulbs, $3 worth of cups, and $4 worth of cockroach traps. Knowing that a 10% tax applies to all non-food items, how much did it all cost?

question: Kim a créé sa propre compagnie d'entretien et calcule le bénéfice qu'il pourra tirer de sa clientèle. Il a déjà 3 clients, mais sa discussion avec 5 autres clients potentiels le rend assez confiant pour les inclure dans ses calculs. 2 bouteilles d'eau de Javel et un paquet de chiffons seront nécessaire pour entretenir la maison de chaque clients. Il faudra débourser 2 $ par bouteille d'eau de Javel et 5 $ par paquet de chiffons. Ce sont ses seules dépenses. Il calcule que son revenu total chaque semaine sera de 92 $. Le bénéfice étant la différence entre le revenu total et les dépenses totales, quel bénéfice, en dollars, Kim fera-t-il chaque semaine ?
translated_en: Kim has started his own cleaning company and is calculating his profit. He already has three clients, but talking with five more potential clients makes him confident enough to include them in his calculations. Two bottles of bleach and a pack of rags will be needed to clean each client's house. He will have to spend $2 per bottle of bleach and $5 per pack of rags. These are his only expenses. He calculates that his total weekly income will be $92. Profit being the difference between total income and total expenses, what profit, in dollars, will Kim make each week?

question: Jean possède un champ d'ananas de 10 hectares. Sachant qu'il y a 100 ananas par hectare et que Jean les récolte tous les 3 mois, combien peut-il en récolter en un an ?
translated_en: Jean owns a 10-hectare pineapple field. Knowing that there are 100 pineapples per hectare and that Jean harvests them every 3 months, how many can he harvest in a year?

question: Johnny ramasse les jouets qui traînent dans sa chambre. Il a fait tomber un jeu de lego de 500 pièces, un autre avec 3 fois plus de pièces, ainsi qu'un dernier comptant 1/4 du nombre de pièces. Combien de pièces Johnny ramasse-t-il en tout ?
translated_en: Johnny is picking up the toys lying around in his room. He knocked over a 500-piece Lego set, another with three times as many pieces, and a final one with a quarter of the number of pieces. How many pieces does Johnny pick up in total?

question: Debra surveille une ruche pour voir combien d'abeilles entrent et sortent en une journée. Elle voit 30 abeilles quitter la ruche dans les 6 premières heures, puis en voit la moitié revenir dans les 6 heures suivantes. Ensuite, au cours des 6 heures qui suivent, elle voit s'envoler deux fois plus d'abeilles que celles qui ont quitté la ruche la première fois. Puis, durant les 6 heures suivantes, toutes les abeilles qui étaient sorties et n'étaient pas encore revenues regagnent la ruche. Combien d'abeilles Debra a-t-elle vu revenir à la ruche au cours des 6 dernières heures de la journée ?
translated_en: Debra is monitoring a beehive to see how many bees enter and leave in a day. She sees 30 bees leave the hive in the first 6 hours, and then half of them return in the next 6 hours. Then, in the following 6 hours, she sees twice as many bees fly out as left the hive the first time. Finally, in the last 6 hours, all the bees that had left and hadn't yet returned come back to the hive. How many bees did Debra see return to the hive in the last 6 hours of the day?

question: Brittany et sa mère vont au musée. Le prix de l'entrée est de 12 $ pour les adultes et de 10 $ pour les enfants. La mère de Brittany donne à la caissière de l'argent pour 1 billet enfant et 1 billet adulte. Si elle a reçu une différence de 8 $, combien d'argent, en dollars, a-t-elle donné à la caissière ?
translated_en: Brittany and her mother are going to the museum. The entrance fee is $12 for adults and $10 for children. Brittany's mother gives the cashier money for one child's ticket and one adult ticket. If she received a difference of $8, how much money, in dollars, did she give the cashier?

question: Charlie a trois fois plus d'amis Facebook que Dorothée. Jacques en a quatre fois plus que Dorothée. Si Charlie a 12 amis Facebook, combien en a Jacques ?
translated_en: Charlie has three times as many Facebook friends as Dorothy. Jacques has four times as many as Dorothy. If Charlie has 12 Facebook friends, how many does Jacques have?

question: Steve et Tim décident de voir lequel des deux rentrera le plus vite de l'école. Steve habite plus loin que Tim et a donc le droit d'utiliser son vélo. Steve habite à 3 miles de l'école et pédale à 440 pieds par minute. Tim habite à 2 miles de l'école. Si Tim se déplace en skateboard à une vitesse de 264 pieds par minute, combien de temps le gagnant attendra-t-il chez lui avant que le perdant ne termine la course ?
translated_en: Steve and Tim decide to see who can get home from school the fastest. Steve lives farther away than Tim and is therefore allowed to use his bicycle. Steve lives 3 miles from school and pedals at 440 feet per minute. Tim lives 2 miles from school. If Tim travels by skateboard at a speed of 264 feet per minute, how long will the winner have to wait at home before the loser finishes the race?

question: Shawnda pense qu'un service de gonflage de vélos serait très utile aux enfants de son quartier. Elle choisit de facturer au pneu. Le gonflage de chaque pneu coûte 25 cents. Le premier jour, 5 personnes sont venues faire gonfler les deux pneus de chacun de leurs vélos. 3 personnes sont venues faire gonfler tous les pneus de leurs tricycles. Enfin, une personne est venue en monocycle. Combien d'argent a-t-elle gagné ce jour-là ?
translated_en: Shawnda thinks a bicycle inflation service would be very useful to the children in her neighborhood. She decides to charge per tire. Inflating each tire costs 25 cents. On the first day, 5 people came to have both tires of each of their bicycles inflated. 3 people came to have all the tires of their tricycles inflated. Finally, one person came on a unicycle. How much money did she earn that day?

question: Carl achète dix paquets de cookies. Chaque paquet contient six biscuits. Chaque biscuit coûte 0,10 $. Combien de monnaie reçoit Carl s'il paie avec un billet de 10 $ ?
translated_en: Carl buys ten packs of cookies. Each pack contains six cookies. Each cookie costs $0.10. How much change does Carl receive if he pays with a $10 bill?

question: Dave a acheté un gros paquet de frites et en a mangé quatorze avant qu'une mouette affamée ne lui vole le paquet des mains. Lorsque la mouette s'est posée, elle a englouti la moitié de la quantité de frites que Dave avait mangée. Ensuite, trois pigeons ont forcé la mouette à s'éloigner de la nourriture et chacun d'eux a pu manger trois frites. Plus tard, un raton laveur a volé deux tiers des frites restantes. Les fourmis en ont emporté une dernière, abandonnant cinq frites. Combien de frites y avait-il dans le paquet lorsque Dave l'a acheté ?
translated_en: Dave bought a large bag of fries and ate fourteen before a hungry seagull snatched the bag from his hands. When the seagull landed, it gobbled up half the amount of fries Dave had eaten. Then, three pigeons drove the seagull away from the food, and each of them got to eat three fries. Later, a raccoon stole two-thirds of the remaining fries. The ants took one last one, leaving five fries. How many fries were in the bag when Dave bought it?

question: Les lundis, mercredis et vendredis, l'étudiant Kimo a trois cours d'une heure par jour. Les mardis et jeudis, il a deux cours de 2 heures chaque jour. S'il y a 16 semaines d'école par semestre, combien d'heures Kimo consacre-t-il à ses cours durant un semestre ?
translated_en: On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, student Kimo has three one-hour classes per day. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, he has two two-hour classes each day. If there are 16 weeks of school per semester, how many hours does Kimo spend in class during a semester?

question: Chaque jour, Bill prépare 300 petits pains, 120 croissants au chocolat et 60 baguettes. Les petits pains mesurent 4 pouces chacun, les croissants 6 pouces chacun et les baguettes deux pieds chacun. Si Bill met tous les produits de boulangerie bout à bout, quelle sera leur longueur en pieds ?
translated_en: Every day, Bill bakes 300 rolls, 120 chocolate croissants, and 60 baguettes. The rolls are 4 inches each, the croissants 6 inches each, and the baguettes 2 feet each. If Bill lays all the baked goods end to end, what will their length be in feet?

question: Pour nourrir les singes du zoo, le gardien commande des bananes à une ferme locale tous les 2 mois. S'il faut 200 bananes pour les macaques, 400 pour les gorilles et 100 pour les babouins, combien doit-il en commander pour tenir durant les 2 mois ?
translated_en: To feed the monkeys at the zoo, the keeper orders bananas from a local farm every two months. If 200 bananas are needed for the macaques, 400 for the gorillas, and 100 for the baboons, how many should he order to last for the two months?

question: Blake et Kelly s'affrontent pour savoir qui peut courir le plus en 15 minutes. Ils décident de le faire sur un terrain de football de 100 yards de long. Blake fait 15 allers-retours. Kelly fait un aller-retour, puis décide qu'elle ne veut pas courir aux côtés de Blake. Elle commence donc à faire l'aller-retour en se limitant à la ligne des 40 yards. Elle le fait 34 fois. Combien de yards le gagnant a-t-il couru de plus que le perdant ?
translated_en: Blake and Kelly have a race to see who can run the most in 15 minutes. They decide to do it on a 100-yard football field. Blake runs 15 laps. Kelly runs one lap, then decides she doesn't want to run alongside Blake. So she starts running laps, limiting herself to the 40-yard line. She does this 34 times. How many more yards did the winner run than the loser?

question: Raphael est allé acheter des fournitures scolaires. Il a acheté 4 stylos de 1,5 $ chacun, 2 cahiers de 4 $ chacun et du papier bond pour 20 $. Combien Raphael a-t-il dépensé pour tout cela ?
translated_en: Raphael went to buy school supplies. He bought 4 pens at $1.50 each, 2 notebooks at $4 each, and bond paper for $20. How much did Raphael spend on all of this?

question: Finn observe 11 têtards qui nagent dans l'étang. Il en voit soudain 6 sortir de dessous un nénuphar, puis 2 se cacher sous un rocher. Combien de têtards Finn peut-il maintenant voir dans l'étang ?
translated_en: Finn observes 11 tadpoles swimming in the pond. He suddenly sees 6 of them emerge from under a lily pad, then 2 hide under a rock. How many tadpoles can Finn now see in the pond?

question: Un réservoir d'eau a une profondeur de 17 pieds le lundi. Le mardi, le réservoir contient 7 pieds d'eau en plus. Le mercredi, la profondeur de l'eau représente les deux tiers de ce qu'elle était le mardi. Quelle est la profondeur de l'eau du réservoir le mercredi ?
translated_en: A water tank is 17 feet deep on Monday. On Tuesday, the tank is 7 feet deeper. On Wednesday, the water level is two-thirds of what it was on Tuesday. What is the water level in the tank on Wednesday?

question: Anakin et Locsin sont allés à la plage aujourd'hui. Anakin a attrapé 10 étoiles de mer, 6 hippocampes et 3 poissons-clowns. Locsin a attrapé 5 étoiles de mer de moins qu'Anakin, 3 hippocampes de moins qu'Anakin et 2 poissons-clowns de plus qu'Anakin. Combien de poissons ont-ils attrapé tous les deux ?
translated_en: Anakin and Locsin went to the beach today. Anakin caught 10 starfish, 6 seahorses, and 3 clownfish. Locsin caught 5 fewer starfish than Anakin, 3 fewer seahorses than Anakin, and 2 more clownfish than Anakin. How many fish did they both catch?

question: Si un sac de billes coûte 20 $ et que le prix de départ augmente de 20 % tous les deux mois, combien coûtera un sac de billes après 36 mois ?
translated_en: If a bag of marbles costs $20 and the starting price increases by 20% every two months, how much will a bag of marbles cost after 36 months?

question: Plusieurs jouets sont disposés dans une chambre : 5 voitures rouges, 3 figurines et une poupée. La poupée coûte le prix des 3 figurines, et une voiture rouge coûte 4 $. Sachant qu'une figurine coûte 5 $, quelle est la valeur totale des jouets ?
translated_en: Several toys are arranged in a room: 5 red cars, 3 action figures, and a doll. The doll costs the same as the 3 action figures, and a red car costs $4. Knowing that an action figure costs $5, what is the total value of the toys?

question: Jackie se demande si elle doit faire ses déclarations d'impôts elle-même ou engager un comptable. En le faisant elle-même, elle pourra faire 3 heures de freelance en moins, ce qui représente un manque à gagner de 35 $ par heure. Le comptable lui demande 90 $. Combien d'argent aura-t-elle en plus si elle l'engage ?
translated_en: Jackie is wondering whether to file her taxes herself or hire an accountant. Doing it herself will save her 3 hours of freelance work, which represents a loss of $35 per hour. The accountant charges $90. How much more money will she have if she hires one?

question: Pour ses 30 ans, Elvira a choisi comme cadeau un nouvel ordinateur avec de nombreux accessoires. Elle dispose d'un budget de 1 500 € offert par toute sa famille et pense qu'elle pourra en garder un peu pour s'offrir un vêtement. Elle se rend dans un magasin d'informatique et choisit une appareil qui coûte 1090 € avec un écran, un clavier et une souris. Elle se procure également un scanner de 157 €, un graveur de CD de 74 € et une imprimante de 102 €. Combien d'argent lui restera-t-il pour ses vêtements ?
translated_en: For her 30th birthday, Elvira chose a new computer with many accessories as a gift. She has a budget of €1,500, a gift from her family, and thinks she'll be able to save some for clothes. She goes to a computer store and chooses a machine that costs €1,090, including a monitor, keyboard, and mouse. She also buys a scanner for €157, a CD burner for €74, and a printer for €102. How much money will she have left for clothes?

question: La voisine de Sandra lui remet un panier de 9 œufs chaque fois qu'elle garde sa fille. Pour faire un flan espagnol, Sandra a besoin de 3 œufs. Si elle a été chargée de faire 15 gâteaux à la crème pour la collecte de fonds de son école, combien de fois doit-elle garder l'enfant ?
translated_en: Sandra's neighbor gives her a basket of 9 eggs every time she babysits her daughter. To make a Spanish flan, Sandra needs 3 eggs. If she has been tasked with making 15 cream cakes for her school's fundraiser, how many times does she need to babysit?

question: Seth est 2 fois plus âgé que Brooke. Dans deux ans, la somme de leurs âges sera de 28 ans. Quel est l'âge de Seth ?
translated_en: Seth is twice as old as Brooke. In two years, the sum of their ages will be 28. How old is Seth?

question: Jimmy a 2 $ de plus que le double de l'argent d'Ethel. Si Ethel a 8 $, combien d'argent a Jimmy ?
translated_en: Jimmy has $2 more than twice Ethel's money. If Ethel has $8, how much money does Jimmy have?

question: En dehors du weekend où il marche 10 miles, Pancho fait 20 miles tous les jours. Combien de miles parcourt-il à la marche en une semaine ?
translated_en: Aside from the weekend when he walks 10 miles, Pancho walks 20 miles every day. How many miles does he walk in a week?

question: La fanfare commande de nouveaux uniformes. Chaque uniforme comprend un chapeau qui coûte 25 $, une veste trois fois plus chère que le chapeau et un pantalon dont le prix équivaut à la moyenne des prix du chapeau et de la veste. Quel est le coût total de chaque uniforme ?
translated_en: The marching band orders new uniforms. Each uniform includes a hat that costs $25, a jacket that costs three times as much as the hat, and pants that cost the average of the hat and jacket. What is the total cost of each uniform?

question: Jake se promène dans le musée d'entomologie. Il voit 80 araignées à 8 pattes, 90 insectes à 6 pattes, et 3 invertébrés mutants rares à 10 pattes. Combien de pattes Jake voit-il au total ?
translated_en: Jake is walking around the entomology museum. He sees 80 eight-legged spiders, 90 six-legged insects, and 3 rare ten-legged mutant invertebrates. How many legs does Jake see in total?

question: Il y a quatre oiseaux au Caboose. Sally Two a trois ans de plus que Granny Red. Granny Red est deux fois plus âgée que Sally Four. Si Sally Four a le même âge que Sally Thirtytwo, et que Sally Thirtytwo a 8 ans, quel est l'âge total des quatre oiseaux ?
translated_en: There are four birds at Caboose. Sally Two is three years older than Granny Red. Granny Red is twice as old as Sally Four. If Sally Four is the same age as Sally Thirtytwo, and Sally Thirtytwo is 8 years old, what is the combined age of the four birds?

question: Jessica se demande combien d'argent elle doit payer chaque mois pour couvrir toutes ses dettes. Le paiement minimum de son prêt étudiant est de 300 $ par mois, celui de sa carte de crédit est de 200 $ par mois et celui de son prêt hypothécaire est de 500 $ par mois. Si Jessica veut payer 50 % de plus que le minimum, combien doit-elle payer en un an ?
translated_en: Jessica is wondering how much money she needs to pay each month to cover all her debts. Her minimum student loan payment is $300 per month, her credit card payment is $200 per month, and her mortgage payment is $500 per month. If Jessica wants to pay 50% more than the minimum, how much will she have to pay in a year?

question: Billy épluche et découpe des pommes de terre afin de préparer une salade de pommes de terre pour son grand barbecue de famille. Comme il s'agit d'un événement important, il a 60 pommes de terre à éplucher. Les pommes de terre sont à peu près de la même taille, il faut donc à peu près le même temps pour les éplucher et les découper. Il faut à Billy environ une minute et demie pour éplucher une pomme de terre, mais seulement 5 secondes pour la couper. Combien de temps faut-il à Billy pour finir de préparer les pommes de terre ?
translated_en: Billy is peeling and chopping potatoes to prepare a potato salad for his big family barbecue. Since it's a big event, he has 60 potatoes to peel. The potatoes are all roughly the same size, so it takes about the same amount of time to peel and chop them. It takes Billy about a minute and a half to peel a potato, but only 5 seconds to chop it. How long does it take Billy to finish preparing the potatoes?

question: Juan et son frère Carlos vendent de la limonade. Pour chaque gallon ils dépensent 3 $ en citrons et 2 $ en sucre. Ils obtiennent 20 verres de limonade et les vendent à 0,50 $ le verre. S'ils ont réalisé un bénéfice de 25 $, combien ont-ils dépensé pour les citrons ?
translated_en: Juan and his brother Carlos sell lemonade. For each gallon they spend $3 on lemons and $2 on sugar. They get 20 glasses of lemonade and sell them for $0.50 each. If they made a profit of $25, how much did they spend on lemons?

question: Dans une course réunissant 240 asiatiques, 80 d'entre eux étaient japonais et les autres chinois. Si le nombre de garçons dans l'équipe chinoise était de 60, combien de filles y avait-il dans cette même équipe ?
translated_en: In a race with 240 Asian participants, 80 were Japanese and the rest were Chinese. If the number of boys on the Chinese team was 60, how many girls were on the same team?

question: Zaid dépense 1/4 de son salaire pour le loyer, 1/3 pour le carburant de sa voiture et fait don de la moitié du montant restant à son association caritative préférée. Il donne 200 $ à sa fille pour ses dépenses hebdomadaires et 700 $ à sa femme pour l'épicerie et les autres produits ménagers. Si Zaid gagne 6 000 $ par mois, combien d'argent lui restera-t-il après toutes ces dépenses et ces dons ?
translated_en: Zaid spends 1/4 of his salary on rent, 1/3 on gas for his car, and donates half of the remaining amount to his favorite charity. He gives his daughter $200 for her weekly expenses and his wife $700 for groceries and other household items. If Zaid earns $6,000 a month, how much money will he have left after all these expenses and donations?

question: Rani a dix crabes de plus que Monique, laquelle a 4 crabes de moins que Bo. Sachant que Bo a 40 crabes, calcule le nombre total de crabes.
translated_en: Rani has ten more crabs than Monique, who has four fewer crabs than Bo. Knowing that Bo has 40 crabs, calculate the total number of crabs.

question: Lloyd gagne 10 $ de l'heure en donnant des cours particuliers de mathématiques. Il a donné 5 heures de cours la première semaine et 8 heures la semaine suivante. Combien a-t-il gagné pour les deux premières semaines ?
translated_en: Lloyd earns $10 an hour tutoring math. He tutored for 5 hours the first week and 8 hours the following week. How much did he earn for the first two weeks?

question: Deux candidats briguent le poste de délégué de classe à l'école de Sarai. Si le gagnant a obtenu 3/4 des voix et que le nombre total d'élèves ayant voté est de 80, calculez le nombre de voix obtenues par le perdant.
translated_en: Two candidates are vying for the position of class representative at Sarai's school. If the winner received 3/4 of the votes and the total number of students who voted is 80, calculate the number of votes obtained by the loser.

question: Sandra, la fleuriste du coin, est très mécontente de la livraison incomplète effectuée par Fred. Sandra avait commandé quatre fois plus de roses rouges que d'œillets blancs. Elle avait également commandé 200 lys de calla roses, soit cinq fois la quantité d'œillets blancs. Sandra a menacé de changer de fournisseur si les roses rouges manquantes ne sont pas livrées avant 17 heures. Pour garder Sandra comme cliente, combien de roses rouges Fred doit-il livrer avant 17 heures ?
translated_en: Sandra, the local florist, is very unhappy with Fred's incomplete delivery. Sandra had ordered four times as many red roses as white carnations. She had also ordered 200 pink calla lilies, five times the number of white carnations. Sandra threatened to change suppliers if the missing red roses aren't delivered by 5 p.m. To keep Sandra as a customer, how many red roses must Fred deliver before 5 p.m.?

question: Jean a deux ans de plus que Marc. Il y a deux ans, Marc avait 5 ans de plus que la moitié de l'âge de Jan. Si Jan a 30 ans, quel âge a Jean ?
translated_en: Jean is two years older than Marc. Two years ago, Marc was five years older than half of Jean's age. If Jean is 30 years old, how old is Jean?

question: Deux équipes d'athlétisme s'affrontent dans un relais de 4 x 400 mètres, une course où chaque équipe compte quatre membres qui courent chacun 400 mètres, ou un tour de piste standard. L'une des deux équipes est très bien rodée et chacun de ses membres fait ses 400 mètres en 55 secondes exactement. L'autre équipe est moins bien rodée. Son premier coureur fait 400 mètres en 60 secondes, puis chaque coureur suivant est 3 secondes plus rapide que le précédent. Sur la base de ces informations, en combien de secondes l'équipe la plus rapide gagnera-t-elle ?
translated_en: Two track and field teams are competing in a 4 x 400-meter relay, a race where each team has four members who each run 400 meters, or one lap of a standard track. One of the teams is very well-trained, and each of its members completes their 400 meters in exactly 55 seconds. The other team is less well-trained. Its first runner completes 400 meters in 60 seconds, and each subsequent runner is 3 seconds faster than the one before them. Based on this information, by how many seconds will the faster team win?

question: Jerry lance un dé à six faces. Quelle est la probabilité (en pourcentage) qu'il obtienne un nombre supérieur à 3 plutôt qu'un nombre pair deux fois de suite ?
translated_en: Jerry rolls a six-sided die. What is the probability (as a percentage) that he will roll a number greater than 3 rather than an even number twice in a row?

question: Jenna et sa mère ont cueilli des pommes dans leur ferme. Jenna a ramassé deux fois moins de pommes que sa mère. Si sa mère en a ramassé 20, combien de pommes ont-elles ramassé en tout ?
translated_en: Jenna and her mother picked apples on their farm. Jenna picked half as many apples as her mother. If her mother picked 20, how many apples did they pick in total?

question: Russell travaille dans une animalerie et distribue de la paille aux rongeurs. Les rats sont répartis dans 3 cages par groupes de taille égale et chaque rat reçoit 6 morceaux de paille. Il y a 10 cages de hamsters. Chacun d'eux est seul dans sa cage et reçoit 5 morceaux de paille. Il y a aussi un enclos de lapins où l'on distribue 20 morceaux de paille. Aucune paille n'est utilisée ailleurs dans le magasin. Si 160 morceaux de paille ont été distribués aux petits rongeurs, combien de rats y a-t-il dans chaque cage ?
translated_en: Russell works in a pet shop and distributes straw to the rodents. The rats are divided into 3 cages in equal groups, and each rat receives 6 pieces of straw. There are 10 hamster cages. Each hamster is alone in its cage and receives 5 pieces of straw. There is also a rabbit enclosure where 20 pieces of straw are distributed. No straw is used anywhere else in the shop. If 160 pieces of straw were distributed to the small rodents, how many rats are in each cage?

question: Mandy a une dette de 100 $ envers Benedict. Ils ont convenu d'un intérêt mensuel de 2 %. Si Mandy est en mesure de payer cette somme au bout de 3 mois, quel montant doit-elle donner à Benoît ?
translated_en: Mandy owes Benedict $100. They agreed on a monthly interest rate of 2%. If Mandy is able to pay this amount in 3 months, how much should she give Benedict?

question: Un commerçant achète quelques sacs de blé à un agriculteur au prix de 20 $ le sac. Sachant que le transport d'un sac de la ferme à l'entrepôt coûte 2 $ et que tous les sacs ont été vendus à 30 $ le sac pour un bénéfice total de 400 $, combien de sacs a-t-il vendus ?
translated_en: A merchant buys a few bags of wheat from a farmer at $20 per bag. Knowing that transporting a bag from the farm to the warehouse costs $2 and that all the bags were sold at $30 per bag for a total profit of $400, how many bags did he sell?

question: Trois amis ont dépensé 20,25 $ pour 3 billets d'entrée à la foire. Ils ont également dépensé 4,50 $ de moins pour la nourriture qu'ils n'en ont dépensé pour les billets. Ils ont également fait 2 tours de manège à 33 $ le tour. S'ils ont convenu de partager les frais équitablement, combien chacun a-t-il payé ?
translated_en: Three friends spent $20.25 on three admission tickets to the fair. They also spent $4.50 less on food than they spent on tickets. They also took two rides at $33 each. If they agreed to split the costs equally, how much did each person pay?

question: Jean cueille des pêches pendant 3 heures. Il ramasse 2 pêches par minute. Combien de pêches a-t-il ramassé ?
translated_en: Jean picks peaches for 3 hours. He picks 2 peaches per minute. How many peaches did he pick?

question: Les canards ont besoin de manger 3,5 livres d'insectes par semaine pour survivre. Combien de livres d'insectes faut-il par jour à un troupeau de dix canards ?
translated_en: Ducks need to eat 3.5 pounds of insects per week to survive. How many pounds of insects does a flock of ten ducks need per day?

question: Tom plante 10 arbres par an. Il abat également 2 arbres chaque année. Il commence avec 50 arbres. Au bout de 10 ans, 30 % des arbres meurent. Combien d'arbres lui reste-t-il ?
translated_en: Tom plants 10 trees a year. He also cuts down 2 trees each year. He starts with 50 trees. After 10 years, 30% of the trees die. How many trees does he have left?

question: Sue habite un quartier où règne la bonne humeur. Au cours d'un certain week-end, les voisins ont décidé de lui faire une farce. Le vendredi matin, ils ont placé 18 flamants roses en plastique dans son jardin. Le samedi matin, les voisins ont repris un tiers des flamants roses qu'ils ont peints en blanc et replacés dans le jardin de Sue. Puis, le dimanche matin, ils ont ajouté 18 autres flamants roses en plastique à la collection. À midi, le dimanche, quelle quantité de flamants roses en plastique y avait-il de plus que celle des flamants blancs ?
translated_en: Sue lives in a cheerful neighborhood. One weekend, her neighbors decided to play a prank on her. On Friday morning, they placed 18 plastic flamingos in her garden. On Saturday morning, the neighbors took away a third of the flamingos, painted them white, and put them back in Sue's garden. Then, on Sunday morning, they added another 18 plastic flamingos to the collection. At noon on Sunday, how many more plastic flamingos were there than white ones?

question: Violetta veut acheter de nouveaux crayons. Elle en a besoin dans 5 couleurs différentes et a prévu 20 $ pour cet achat. Sachant qu'un crayon coûte 2 $, combien aura-t-elle de monnaie ?
translated_en: Violetta wants to buy new crayons. She needs them in 5 different colors and has budgeted $20 for this purchase. Knowing that a crayon costs $2, how much change will she have?

question: Un stylo coûte autant qu'un crayon et une gomme réunis. Si un crayon coûte 1,20 $ et une gomme 0,30 $, quel sera le prix de 8 stylos ?
translated_en: A pen costs the same as a pencil and an eraser combined. If a pencil costs $1.20 and an eraser $0.30, what will be the price of 8 pens?

question: Il faut distribuer 200 livres de carottes à 40 restaurants d'une certaine ville. Si chaque restaurant doit recevoir 2 livres de carottes, combien de livres de carottes ne seront pas utilisées ?
translated_en: 200 pounds of carrots need to be distributed to 40 restaurants in a certain city. If each restaurant is to receive 2 pounds of carrots, how many pounds of carrots will go unused?

question: Dans la ville de Soda, il y a exactement 23 786 habitants. 8 417 d'entre eux sont des hommes et 9 092 des femmes. Le reste de la population est composé d'enfants. Combien d'enfants y a-t-il à Soda ?
translated_en: The city of Soda has exactly 23,786 inhabitants. 8,417 of them are men and 9,092 are women. The rest of the population is made up of children. How many children are there in Soda?

question: Au départ, Elaine avait 20 cartes Pokemon. Elle en a collecté trois fois plus au bout d'un mois. Au cours du deuxième mois, elle a collecté 20 cartes de moins que celles collectées le premier mois. Enfin, au cours du troisième mois, elle a collecté deux fois le nombre total de cartes collecté les deux premiers mois. Combien de cartes Pokemon possède-t-elle maintenant ?
translated_en: Initially, Elaine had 20 Pokémon cards. She collected three times as many after one month. During the second month, she collected 20 fewer cards than she had collected in the first month. Finally, during the third month, she collected twice the total number of cards collected in the first two months. How many Pokémon cards does she have now?

question: Marc est un réviseur. Il révise le même nombre de phrases chaque semaine pour deux éditeurs différents, qui le paient chacun à un taux différent. L'éditeur B paie Marc deux fois plus que l'éditeur A. Marc édite un total de 1 000 phrases par semaine, tandis que l'éditeur A lui verse 5 cents par phrase. Combien Marc gagne-t-il en une semaine, en centimes ?
translated_en: Marc is a proofreader. He proofreads the same number of sentences each week for two different publishers, who each pay him a different rate. Publisher B pays Marc twice as much as Publisher A. Marc proofreads a total of 1,000 sentences per week, while Publisher A pays him 5 cents per sentence. How much does Marc earn in one week, in cents?

question: Baldur puise de l'eau d'un puits. Il en tire 5 seaux le matin et 6 seaux l'après-midi. Si chaque seau contient 5 litres d'eau, combien de litres d'eau récupère-t-il chaque jour ?
translated_en: Baldur draws water from a well. He takes 5 buckets in the morning and 6 buckets in the afternoon. If each bucket contains 5 liters of water, how many liters of water does he collect each day?

question: Jean reçoit un prix au travail. Ce prix consiste en une prime unique de 5 000 $ et une augmentation de salaire de 5 %. S'il gagne 2 000 $ par semaine, chaque semaine de l'année, et qu'il a reçu le prix le premier jour de l'année, combien d'argent a-t-il gagné cette année-là ?
translated_en: John receives a work award. This award consists of a one-time bonus of $5,000 and a 5% salary increase. If he earns $2,000 per week, every week of the year, and he received the award on the first day of the year, how much money did he earn that year?

question: Josie cultive des raisins dans sa ferme de 10 acres. Elle y produit 5 tonnes de raisin par an sur chaque acre, et chaque tonne de raisin produit 2 barils de vin. Combien de barils de vin sa ferme produit-elle par an ?
translated_en: Josie grows grapes on her 10-acre farm. She produces 5 tons of grapes per acre per year, and each ton of grapes produces 2 barrels of wine. How many barrels of wine does her farm produce per year?

question: Le fromage est l'aliment préféré de Carl. Il a mangé un sandwich tous les jours de la semaine au déjeuner et a utilisé 2 tranches de fromage dans chaque sandwich. Il a mangé des omelettes au fromage et aux œufs pour le petit déjeuner 3 jours dans la semaine, en utilisant une tranche de plus par omelette qu'il n'en a utilisé par sandwich. Il a fait un grand plat de macaroni au fromage pour assurer plusieurs dîners cette semaine et a utilisé 8 tranches de fromage dans sa préparation. Combien de tranches de fromage a-t-il utilisées en tout ?
translated_en: Cheese is Carl's favorite food. He ate a sandwich every day for lunch that week and used 2 slices of cheese in each sandwich. He ate cheese and egg omelets for breakfast 3 days that week, using one more slice per omelet than he used per sandwich. He made a large dish of macaroni and cheese to provide several dinners that week and used 8 slices of cheese in its preparation. How many slices of cheese did he use in total?

question: Janet disposait de 22 stylos verts et de 10 stylos jaunes. Elle a ensuite acheté 6 sacs de stylos bleus et 2 sacs de stylos rouges. Chaque sac de stylos bleus en contenait 9 et chaque sac de stylos rouges 6. De combien de stylos Janet dispose-t-elle maintenant ?
translated_en: Janet had 22 green pens and 10 yellow pens. She then bought 6 bags of blue pens and 2 bags of red pens. Each bag of blue pens contained 9 pens and each bag of red pens contained 6. How many pens does Janet have now?

question: Brinley est dans la classe de mathématiques de M. Bert. Ce dernier fait passer six tests par semestre. Il autorise les élèves à retirer la plus mauvaise moyenne de chaque semestre. Si, lors des cinq premiers tests, Brinley a obtenu des notes de 89, 71, 92, 100 et 86, quelle note doit-elle obtenir au sixième test pour avoir une moyenne de 93 ?
translated_en: Brinley is in Mr. Bert's math class. Mr. Bert administers six tests per semester. He allows students to drop their lowest average from each semester. If Brinley scored 89, 71, 92, 100, and 86 on the first five tests, what score must she get on the sixth test to have an average of 93?

question: Micheal adore faire du vélo. Il en fait au moins 5 fois par semaine et fait 25 kilomètres à chaque fois. Il l'a fait pendant quatre semaines, puis il a décidé de n'en faire que 2 fois par semaine, mais en parcourant 60 kilomètres à chaque fois, ce qu'il a fait pendant 3 semaines. Combien de kilomètres Micheal a-t-il fait au total ?
translated_en: Michael loves cycling. He rides at least 5 times a week, covering 25 kilometers each time. He did this for four weeks, then decided to reduce it to 2 times a week, but covering 60 kilometers each time, which he did for 3 weeks. How many kilometers did Michael ride in total?

question: Le sac de bonbons d'Halloween de Joe contient 25 barres de chocolat et 80 pommes confites. Chaque barre de chocolat pèse deux fois plus qu'une pomme confite. Si la barre de chocolat pèse 40 g, quel est le poids, en grammes, du sac de bonbons de Joe ?
translated_en: Joe's Halloween candy bag contains 25 chocolate bars and 80 candied apples. Each chocolate bar weighs twice as much as a candied apple. If the chocolate bar weighs 40 g, what is the weight, in grams, of Joe's candy bag?

question: Lundi, Rose est allée acheter 4 gâteaux dans un magasin. Mardi, elle a acheté trois fois plus de gâteaux dans un magasin différent. Mercredi, elle s'est rendue dans un autre magasin et a acheté 5 fois la quantité de gâteaux achetée mardi. Combien de gâteaux a-t-elle acheté au total durant ces trois jours ?
translated_en: On Monday, Rose went to buy 4 cakes at a store. On Tuesday, she bought three times as many cakes at a different store. On Wednesday, she went to another store and bought 5 times the number of cakes she bought on Tuesday. How many cakes did she buy in total during these three days?

question: Vingt douzaines de tasses ont coûté 1 200 $ de moins que le coût total d'une demi-douzaine d'assiettes vendues à 6 000 $ chacune. Calculez le prix d'une tasse.
translated_en: Twenty dozen mugs cost $1,200 less than the total cost of half a dozen plates sold at $6,000 each. Calculate the price of one mug.

question: Sara veut s'acheter une nouvelle veste et 2 paires de chaussures. La veste qu'elle a choisie coûte 30 $ et chaque paire de chaussures coûte 20 $. Sara garde les enfants du voisin 4 fois et gagne 5 $ à chaque fois. Ses parents lui donnent 4 $ chaque fois qu'elle tond la pelouse. Si Sarah avait déjà 10 $ d'économies avant de commencer à faire du baby-sitting, combien de fois doit-elle tondre la pelouse avant de pouvoir s'offrir la veste et les chaussures ?
translated_en: Sara wants to buy a new jacket and two pairs of shoes. The jacket she chose costs $30, and each pair of shoes costs $20. Sara babysits her neighbor's children four times and earns $5 each time. Her parents give her $4 each time she mows the lawn. If Sara had $10 in savings before she started babysitting, how many times does she need to mow the lawn before she can afford the jacket and shoes?

question: Jerry a un élevage de poulets. Les poules rouges produisent 3 œufs par jour, et les blanches 5 œufs par jour. Jerry ramasse chaque jour 42 œufs. S'il a deux poulets blancs de plus qu'il y en a de rouges, combien de poulets rouges a-t-il ?
translated_en: Jerry has a chicken farm. The red hens lay 3 eggs a day, and the white hens lay 5 eggs a day. Jerry collects 42 eggs each day. If he has two more white chickens than red ones, how many red chickens does he have?

question: Gary aime se promener au bord du parc local, qui a la forme d'un rectangle de 1,5 miles sur 6. S'il marche à 3 miles par heure, combien d'heures de marche effectue-t-il ?
translated_en: Gary enjoys walking along the edge of the local park, which is shaped like a rectangle measuring 1.5 miles by 6 miles. If he walks at 3 miles per hour, how many hours does he walk?

question: Au magasin à un dollar, Sloane compte 100 clients qui entrent dans le magasin. Le lendemain, elle en compte 50 de plus que le premier jour. Si le troisième jour, le nombre total de clients était de 500, combien de clients a-t-elle comptés ce jour-là ?
translated_en: At the dollar store, Sloane counts 100 customers entering the store. The next day, she counts 50 more than the first day. If on the third day, the total number of customers was 500, how many customers did she count that day?

question: Jerry a deux piscines, toutes deux avec des fuites qui les vident à une vitesse de 4 gallons par minute. Il y a 4 minutes, la grande piscine avait deux fois plus d'eau que la petite. A présent, elle en a quatre fois plus. Quelle est la quantité d'eau de la petite piscine maintenant ?
translated_en: Jerry has two pools, both with leaks that drain them at a rate of 4 gallons per minute. Four minutes ago, the large pool had twice as much water as the small one. Now it has four times as much. How much water is in the small pool now?

question: Lori veut acheter une paire de chaussures à 320,00 $ et une ceinture assortie à 32,00 $. Son emploi à temps partiel lui rapporte 8,00 $ de l'heure. Combien d'heures devra-t-elle travailler avant de pouvoir faire ses achats ?
translated_en: Lori wants to buy a pair of shoes for $320.00 and a matching belt for $32.00. Her part-time job pays her $8.00 an hour. How many hours will she have to work before she can make her purchases?

question: Janeth a emprunté 2 000 $ et a promis de les rendre avec un supplément de 10 % du montant. Si elle doit payer 165 $ par mois pendant 12 mois, combien d'argent restera-t-il à Janeth d'ici là ?
translated_en: Janeth borrowed $2,000 and promised to pay it back with an additional 10% of the amount. If she has to pay $165 per month for 12 months, how much money will Janeth have left by then?

question: Il y a 4 roses dans le vase et 7 dahlias de plus qu'il n'y a de roses. Combien de fleurs y a-t-il au total dans le vase ?
translated_en: There are 4 roses in the vase and 7 more dahlias than roses. How many flowers are in the vase in total?

question: L'âge d'Adrian est trois fois supérieur à celui de Harriet, qui a quant à elle la moitié de l'âge de Zack. Calculez l'âge moyen que les trois auront dans trois ans, si Harriet a actuellement 21 ans.
translated_en: Adrian is three times older than Harriet, who is half Zack's age. Calculate the average age the three will be in three years, assuming Harriet is currently 21.

question: Quatre élèves ont marqué un total de 251 points dans un jeu de société. Naomi en a marqué 68. Yuri a marqué 10 points de plus que la moitié de ceux de Naomi, et Brianna 17 de plus que Naomi. Combien de points Jojo a-t-il marqué ?
translated_en: Four students scored a total of 251 points in a board game. Naomi scored 68. Yuri scored 10 points more than half of Naomi's score, and Brianna scored 17 points more than Naomi. How many points did Jojo score?

question: Il faut à Carmen 10 minutes pour finir une grille de mots croisés et 5 minutes pour une grille de sudoku. Durant le week-end, elle a résolu 3 grilles de mots croisés et 8 grilles de sudoku. Combien de temps a-t-elle passé à jouer à ces jeux ?
translated_en: It takes Carmen 10 minutes to complete a crossword puzzle and 5 minutes for a sudoku puzzle. Over the weekend, she solved 3 crossword puzzles and 8 sudoku puzzles. How much time did she spend playing these games?

question: Un réservoir d'eau contient 120 litres d'eau. Céline en a utilisé 90 litres pour arroser son petit jardin. Elle a ensuite pu récupérer l'eau de pluie qui est deux fois plus importante que ce qui restait. Combien de litres d'eau y a-t-il maintenant dans la citerne ?
translated_en: A water tank holds 120 liters of water. Céline used 90 liters to water her small garden. She was then able to collect rainwater, which is twice as much as what remained. How many liters of water are now in the tank?

question: Andy plante 90 géraniums et 40 pétunias de moins que les géraniums. Combien de fleurs plante-t-il au total ?
translated_en: Andy plants 90 fewer geraniums and 40 fewer petunias than geraniums. How many flowers does he plant in total?

question: Une entreprise dépense 15 000 dollars en publicité pendant un an, puis dépense un tiers de cette somme en publicité pendant une autre année. Quel est le montant total que l'entreprise a dépensé en publicité au cours de ces deux années ?
translated_en: A company spends $15,000 on advertising in one year, then spends one-third of that amount on advertising in another year. What is the total amount the company spent on advertising over those two years?

question: Carlos et Benji sont à la plage. Carlos loue un canoë à 30 dollars de l'heure et Benji loue un bateau banane à 18 dollars de l'heure. Si Carlos utilise son embarcation pendant 3 heures et Benji la sienne pendant 5 heures, à combien s'élèvera le montant total de leurs locations ?
translated_en: Carlos and Benji are at the beach. Carlos rents a canoe for $30 an hour and Benji rents a banana boat for $18 an hour. If Carlos uses his boat for 3 hours and Benji uses his for 5 hours, what will be the total cost of their rentals?

question: André prévoit un voyage en voiture du New Jersey à Rochester. Il lui faut 6 jours pour voyager en bus et la moitié de ce temps pour un voyage en voiture. Combien de jours de voyage lui faudra-t-il s'il prévoit d'aller à Rochester en bus et de rentrer en voiture ?
translated_en: André is planning a road trip from New Jersey to Rochester. It takes him 6 days to travel by bus and half that time by car. How many days will it take him if he plans to go to Rochester by bus and return by car?

question: James compte ses cartes Pokemon. Il en a 30 de type feu, 20 de type herbe et 40 de type eau. S'il perd 8 cartes de type eau et en achète 14 de type herbe, quel est le pourcentage de chance (arrondi au nombre entier le plus proche) qu'une carte choisie au hasard soit de type eau ?
translated_en: James is counting his Pokémon cards. He has 30 Fire-type cards, 20 Grass-type cards, and 40 Water-type cards. If he loses 8 Water-type cards and buys 14 Grass-type cards, what is the percentage chance (rounded to the nearest whole number) that a randomly chosen card will be Water-type?

question: Pour son déjeuner, Chad a commandé un burrito à composer. Le burrito de base coûte 6,50 $. Il ajoute en supplément 2 $ de viande, 1,00 $ de fromage, 1,00 $ d'avocat et 2 sauces à 0,25 $ la sauce. Il choisit l'option premium pour 3,00 $ de plus, ce qui lui permet d'ajouter des frites et une boisson. Il possède une carte cadeau de 5,00 $ qu'il utilise à la caisse. Combien lui reste-t-il à payer ?
translated_en: For lunch, Chad ordered a build-your-own burrito. The basic burrito costs $6.50. He adds $2 worth of meat, $1.00 worth of cheese, $1.00 worth of avocado, and two sauces at $0.25 each. He chooses the premium option for an additional $3.00, which allows him to add fries and a drink. He has a $5.00 gift card that he uses at the register. How much does he still have to pay?

question: Kalinda tente de réaliser un puzzle de 360 pièces avec sa mère. Elle est capable de placer 4 pièces par minute. Sa mère en place deux fois moins par minute. Combien d'heures leur faudra-t-il pour terminer ce puzzle ?
translated_en: Kalinda is trying to complete a 360-piece puzzle with her mother. She can place 4 pieces per minute. Her mother places half as many per minute. How many hours will it take them to finish the puzzle?

question: Une ferme de pastèques a produit 120 bébés pastèques. Ashlyn s'est rendue à la ferme après deux mois et a constaté que 30 % des pastèques étaient prêtes à être récoltées et les a donc ramenées chez elle. À son retour, deux semaines plus tard, 3/4 des pastèques restantes étant prêtes, elle les a récoltées. Combien de pastèques n'étaient pas encore prêtes pour la récolte après ces deux semaines ?
translated_en: A watermelon farm produced 120 baby watermelons. Ashlyn visited the farm after two months and found that 30% of the watermelons were ready to be harvested, so she took them home. When she returned two weeks later, three-quarters of the remaining watermelons were ready, so she harvested them. How many watermelons were not yet ready for harvest after those two weeks?

question: Marc achète une flotte de 12 voitures pour son entreprise. Chaque voiture se vend 20 000 $. Il paie 10 % de taxe sur les voitures, puis 1 000 $ de plus pour l'immatriculation de chacune d'elles. Combien dépense-t-il en tout ?
translated_en: Marc buys a fleet of 12 cars for his business. Each car sells for $20,000. He pays 10% tax on the cars, then another $1,000 for registration for each one. How much does he spend in total?

question: Kylie et Robert aiment aller ramasser des coquillages à la plage. Lundi, Kylie ramasse 5 coquillages de plus que Robert qui lui, en ramasse 20. Mardi, Kylie ramasse 2 fois plus de coquillages qu'elle en a ramassé lundi. Combien de coquillages Kylie a-t-elle ramassés mardi ?
translated_en: Kylie and Robert like to go collecting seashells at the beach. On Monday, Kylie collected 5 more seashells than Robert, who collected 20. On Tuesday, Kylie collected twice as many seashells as she did on Monday. How many seashells did Kylie collect on Tuesday?

question: Dax est allé cueillir des pommes à la ferme et a trouvé deux fois moins d'insectes que de fourmis dans le jardin. S'il y avait 50 fourmis, calcule le nombre total d'insectes dans le jardin.
translated_en: Dax went to pick apples at the farm and found half as many insects as ants in the garden. If there were 50 ants, calculate the total number of insects in the garden.

question: Il y a 36 pingouins qui prennent un bain de soleil dans la neige. Un tiers d'entre eux plongent et nagent dans l'océan. Un autre tiers va à l'intérieur de la grotte pour y manger son dîner. Combien de pingouins continuent à prendre le bain de soleil ?
translated_en: There are 36 penguins sunbathing in the snow. A third of them dive and swim in the ocean. Another third go inside the cave to eat their dinner. How many penguins continue sunbathing?

question: Steve veut désormais manger plus de tomates et décide de faire pousser ses propres tomates cerises. Il en mange deux fois plus que sa copine à raison de 6 par jour. Sachant qu'une vigne produit 3 tomates par semaine, combien de vignes lui faudra-t-il ?
translated_en: Steve now wants to eat more tomatoes and decides to grow his own cherry tomatoes. He eats twice as many as his girlfriend, at a rate of 6 per day. Knowing that one vine produces 3 tomatoes per week, how many vines will he need?

question: Jean commande des pizzas pour les partager avec ses amis. Il y a 20 amis au total, et Jean veut s'assurer que chacun aura 4 parts. Si les pizzas ne sont vendues que coupées en 8 parts, combien de pizzas Jean doit-il commander ?
translated_en: Jean orders pizzas to share with his friends. There are 20 friends in total, and Jean wants to make sure that each one gets 4 slices. If pizzas are only sold cut into 8 slices, how many pizzas should Jean order?

question: Ram utilise de nombreux stylos. Il a découvert qu'il pouvait économiser de l'argent en mélangeant l'encre de cinq stylos vides pour fabriquer un stylo plein. S'il achète 25 stylos qu'il utilise pour fabriquer de nouveaux stylos lorsque l'encre est épuisée, combien de stylos obtiendra-t-il au total ?
translated_en: Ram uses many pens. He discovered he could save money by mixing the ink from five empty pens to make one full pen. If he buys 25 pens and uses them to make new pens when the ink runs out, how many pens will he have in total?

question: Johnny a pris son allocation de 20 $, à laquelle il a ajouté 10 $. Il a ensuite investi cette somme, qui a triplé en un an. Combien d'argent avait-il au bout d'un an ?
translated_en: Johnny took his $20 allowance and added $10 to it. He then invested this sum, which tripled in one year. How much money did he have after one year?

question: Marie a deux ans de moins que Jeanne, qui a cinq ans de plus que Jessa. Si Jessa a 20 ans, quelle est la somme des âges des trois filles ?
translated_en: Marie is two years younger than Jeanne, who is five years older than Jessa. If Jessa is 20 years old, what is the sum of the ages of the three girls?

question: Le bâtiment d'une école abrite 1 000 élèves. Ce bâtiment a 3 entrées A, B et C, qui servent également de sorties. Si, après une réunion, 30 % des élèves sortent du bâtiment par la sortie A, 3/5 par la sortie B et le reste par la sortie C, calculez le nombre d'élèves qui ont emprunté la sortie C.
translated_en: A school building houses 1,000 students. This building has three entrances, A, B, and C, which also serve as exits. If, after a meeting, 30% of the students leave the building through exit A, 3/5 through exit B, and the rest through exit C, calculate the number of students who used exit C.

question: Jacques a 6 bonbons de plus que Robert. Jean en a deux fois plus que Robert. Si Jean a 54 bonbons, combien a-t-il de bonbons de plus que Jacques ?
translated_en: Jacques has 6 more candies than Robert. Jean has twice as many as Robert. If Jean has 54 candies, how many more candies does he have than Jacques?

question: Dolly a deux livres. Pandore n'en a qu'un. Si Dolly et Pandore lisent les livres les unes des autres ainsi que les leurs, combien de livres auront-elles lu en tout à la fin ?
translated_en: Dolly has two books. Pandora has only one. If Dolly and Pandora read each other's books as well as their own, how many books will they have read in total at the end?

question: Mike a été le correspondant de 5 personnes et a ensuite cessé de correspondre avec 2 d'entre elles. Les autres envoient chacune 2 lettres de 5 pages toutes les semaines. Il leur répond de la même façon. S'il peut écrire une page toutes les 6 minutes, combien d'heures passe-t-il à écrire par semaine ?
translated_en: Mike corresponded with 5 people and then stopped corresponding with 2 of them. The others each send 2 five-page letters every week. He replies to them in the same way. If he can write one page every 6 minutes, how many hours does he spend writing per week?

question: Jason a un forfait téléphonique de 1 000 minutes par mois. Chaque jour, il communique avec son patron pendant 15 minutes et ce mois-ci, il a passé 300 minutes d'appels supplémentaires à d'autres personnes. Combien de minutes reste-t-il à Jason si ce mois compte 30 jours ?
translated_en: Jason has a phone plan with 1,000 minutes per month. Each day, he talks to his boss for 15 minutes, and this month he has spent an additional 300 minutes on calls to other people. How many minutes does Jason have left if this month has 30 days?

question: Griffin avait 24 frites mais Kyle en a pris 5. Billy en a pris deux fois plus que Kyle. Ginger a donné à Griffin une poignée de ses frites, puis Colby a pris à Griffin 3 frites de moins que le nombre de frites qu'avait pris Kyle. Si, au final, Griffin disposait de 27 frites, combien de frites Ginger a-t-elle donné à Griffin ?
translated_en: Griffin had 24 fries, but Kyle took 5. Billy took twice as many as Kyle. Ginger gave Griffin a handful of her fries, and then Colby took 3 fewer fries from Griffin than Kyle had taken. If Griffin ended up with 27 fries, how many fries did Ginger give Griffin?

question: Il y a 4 escargots dans un aquarium et 32 dans un autre. La différence entre les quantités d'escargots dans les deux aquariums est égale à deux fois la somme des poissons dans les deux aquariums. Si les deux aquariums contiennent le même nombre de poissons, combien de poissons y a-t-il dans chaque aquarium ?
translated_en: There are 4 snails in one aquarium and 32 in another. The difference between the number of snails in the two aquariums is equal to twice the sum of the number of fish in both aquariums. If both aquariums contain the same number of fish, how many fish are in each aquarium?

question: La maquilleuse de Jeanne lui facture 250 $ de l'heure. Elle a besoin d'un maquillage très coûteux pour un film dans lequel elle joue et cela lui prend 6 heures par jour. Elle doit le faire 4 fois par semaine. Le film dure 5 semaines. Une fois le film terminé, la maquilleuse accorde à Jeanne une remise de 10 % en raison de la quantité de travail effectuée. Combien Jeanne a-t-elle payé ?
translated_en: Jeanne's makeup artist charges her $250 an hour. She needs very expensive makeup for a film she's in, and it takes her 6 hours a day. She has to do it 4 times a week. The film lasts 5 weeks. Once filming is finished, the makeup artist gives Jeanne a 10% discount because of the amount of work done. How much did Jeanne pay?

question: Isabelle a acheté des fournitures pour la fête d'anniversaire de sa petite sœur. Elle a dépensé 12 $ pour les ingrédients du gâteau, 43 $ pour les cadeaux d'anniversaire, 15 $ pour les décorations, 4 $ pour les invitations et 22 $ pour les sacs de goodies destinés aux invités. Elle a partagé le coût en trois, entre elle et ses deux parents. Combien chaque personne a-t-elle payé ?
translated_en: Isabelle bought supplies for her little sister's birthday party. She spent $12 on cake ingredients, $43 on birthday gifts, $15 on decorations, $4 on invitations, and $22 on goody bags for the guests. She split the cost three ways, between herself and her two parents. How much did each person pay?

question: Un chef a acheté 4 sacs d'oignons de 50 livres chacun. Si une livre d'oignons coûte 1,50 $, combien a-t-il dépensé ?
translated_en: A chef bought four 50-pound bags of onions. If one pound of onions costs $1.50, how much did he spend?

question: Lundi, Sue a mangé 4 fois plus de biscuits que sa sœur. Mardi, elle en a mangé deux fois plus que sa sœur. Sa sœur a mangé 5 biscuits lundi et en a mangé 13 le lendemain. Si 1 biscuit contient 200 calories, combien de calories de plus que sa sœur Sue a-t-elle consommées ?
translated_en: On Monday, Sue ate four times as many cookies as her sister. On Tuesday, she ate twice as many as her sister. Her sister ate five cookies on Monday and thirteen the next day. If one cookie contains 200 calories, how many more calories did Sue consume than her sister?

question: Janet의 오리는 하루에 16개의 알을 낳습니다. 그녀는 매일 아침 아침 식사로 세 끼를 먹고, 네 끼로 매일 친구들을 위해 머핀을 굽는다. 그녀는 남은 부분을 매일 농산물 시장에서 신선한 오리알 하나당 2달러에 판매합니다. 그녀는 농산물 직거래 장터에서 매일 얼마를 벌고 있나요?
translated_en: Janet's ducks lay 16 eggs a day. She eats them three times a day for breakfast, and bakes muffins for her friends every day for a fourth meal. She sells the remaining eggs at the farmers market every day for $2 per fresh duck egg. How much does she earn each day at the farmers market?

question: 로브에는 파란색 섬유 2볼트와 흰색 섬유의 절반이 필요합니다. 총 몇 개의 볼트가 필요합니까?
translated_en: The robe requires two bolts of blue fiber and half a bolt of white fiber. How many bolts are needed in total?

question: 조쉬는 집을 뒤집어 보기로 결심합니다. 그는 80,000달러에 집을 구입하고 수리비로 50,000달러를 투자합니다. 이로 인해 집 가치가 150% 증가했습니다. 그는 얼마나 많은 이익을 얻었습니까?
translated_en: Josh decides to flip houses. He buys a house for $80,000 and invests $50,000 in renovations. This increases the value of the house by 150%. How much profit did he make?

question: James는 일주일에 3번 3번의 단거리 달리기를 하기로 결정했습니다. 그는 매 스프린트마다 60미터를 달린다. 그는 일주일에 총 몇 미터를 달리나요?
translated_en: James decided to do three sprints three times a week. He runs 60 meters per sprint. How many meters does he run in total per week?

question: Wendi는 매일 닭 한 마리에게 씨앗, 거저리, 야채가 함유된 혼합 닭 사료 3컵을 먹여 닭의 건강을 유지하도록 돕습니다. 그녀는 세 끼의 식사로 닭에게 사료를 줍니다. 아침에 그녀는 닭떼에게 15컵의 사료를 줍니다. 오후에는 닭에게 25컵의 사료를 더 줍니다. 웬디의 닭 떼가 20마리라면 하루의 마지막 식사에 닭에게 먹이를 주는 데 몇 컵의 사료가 필요합니까?
translated_en: Wendi helps maintain the health of her chickens by feeding them three cups of mixed chicken feed containing seeds, mealworms, and vegetables each day. She feeds her chickens three times a day. In the morning, she feeds her chickens 15 cups of feed. In the afternoon, she feeds her chickens another 25 cups of feed. If Wendi has 20 chickens, how many cups of feed does she need to feed her chickens at their last meal of the day?

question: Kylar는 새 아파트에 쓸 안경을 사러 가게에 갔습니다. 유리 한 잔의 가격은 5달러이지만 두 번째 유리 잔의 가격은 가격의 60%에 불과합니다. Kylar는 안경 16개를 사고 싶어합니다. 그는 그 비용을 얼마나 지불해야 합니까?
translated_en: Kylar goes to the store to buy glasses for his new apartment. One glass costs $5, but a second glass costs only 60% of that price. Kylar wants to buy 16 glasses. How much will he have to pay?

question: 툴루즈에는 찰스턴보다 양이 두 배나 많습니다. 찰스턴에는 시애틀보다 양이 4배나 많습니다. 시애틀에 양이 20마리 있다면 툴루즈, 찰스턴, 시애틀에는 양이 몇 마리나 있습니까?
translated_en: Toulouse has twice as many sheep as Charleston. Charleston has four times as many sheep as Seattle. If Seattle has 20 sheep, how many sheep are there in Toulouse, Charleston, and Seattle?

question: Carla는 200GB 파일을 다운로드하고 있습니다. 일반적으로 그녀는 분당 2GB를 다운로드할 수 있지만 다운로드가 진행되는 동안 40% 동안 Windows는 업데이트를 설치하기 위해 강제로 다시 시작하며 20분이 소요됩니다. 그런 다음 Carla는 다운로드를 처음부터 다시 시작해야 합니다. 파일을 다운로드하는 데 로드가 얼마나 걸리나요?
translated_en: Carla is downloading a 200GB file. Normally, she can download 2GB per minute, but at 40% of the download, Windows forces a restart to install an update, which takes 20 minutes. Carla then has to restart the download from the beginning. How long does it take to download the file?

question: John은 시속 60마일의 속도로 3시간 동안 운전하다가 집에서 매우 중요한 것을 잊어버렸다는 것을 깨닫고 돌아섰습니다. 그는 4시간 안에 집에 가려고 노력하지만 처음 2시간은 정체된 교통 정체 속에서 보냅니다. 그는 다음 30분 동안 시속 30마일의 속도로 운전한 후 남은 4시간 동안 시속 80마일로 운전할 수 있습니다. 그 4시간이 지났을 때 그 사람은 집에서 얼마나 멀리 떨어져 있나요?
translated_en: John drives at 60 mph for three hours, then realizes he's forgotten something very important at home and turns around. He tries to get home within four hours, but spends the first two hours stuck in traffic. He can drive at 30 mph for the next 30 minutes and then 80 mph for the remaining four hours. How far is he from home after those four hours?

question: Eliza의 주당 첫 40시간 근무에 대한 시간당 요율은 $10입니다. 그녀는 또한 정규 시급의 1.2배에 달하는 초과 근무 수당을 받습니다. 엘리자가 이번 주에 45시간 일했다면 이번 주 수입은 얼마입니까?
translated_en: Eliza's hourly rate for the first 40 hours of work per week is $10. She also receives overtime pay equal to 1.2 times her regular hourly rate. If Eliza worked 45 hours this week, how much will she earn this week?

question: 새로운 프로그램은 첫 달에 60건의 다운로드를 기록했습니다. 두 번째 달의 다운로드 수는 첫 달의 다운로드 수의 3배였지만, 세 번째 달에는 30% 감소했습니다. 3개월 동안 프로그램의 총 다운로드 횟수는 얼마나 됩니까?
translated_en: A new program had 60 downloads in its first month. The number of downloads in the second month tripled, but the number dropped by 30% in the third month. What was the total number of downloads for the program over the three months?

question: 툴라는 빵집에 가서 다양한 종류의 페이스트리를 샀습니다. 그녀는 1다스당 68달러인 도넛 3다스, 1다스당 80달러인 미니 컵케이크 2다스, 1다스당 55달러에 미니 치즈케이크 6다스를 구입했습니다. 총 비용은 얼마였나요?
translated_en: Toula went to a bakery and bought a variety of pastries. She bought three dozen donuts for $68 each, two dozen mini cupcakes for $80 each, and six dozen mini cheesecakes for $55 each. What was the total cost?

question: 카를로스는 레몬 나무를 심고 있습니다. 나무를 심는 데는 90달러가 소요됩니다. 매년 레몬 7개가 자라며 그는 레몬 하나당 1.5달러에 팔 수 있습니다. 나무에 물을 주고 먹이를 주는 데 연간 3달러가 듭니다. 그가 레몬나무로 돈을 벌기 시작하려면 몇 년이 걸릴까요?
translated_en: Carlos is planting a lemon tree. It costs him $90 to plant the tree. Each year, it grows seven lemons, which he can sell for $1.50 each. It costs him $3 per year to water and feed the tree. How many years will it take for him to start making money from his lemon tree?

question: 멜라니는 방문판매원이다. 그녀는 진공청소기 중 3분의 1을 온실에 팔았고, 2개를 빨간 집에 더 팔았고, 남은 것의 절반을 오렌지 집에 팔았습니다. 멜라니에게 진공청소기가 5개 남았다면 처음에는 몇 개부터 시작했습니까?
translated_en: Melanie is a door-to-door saleswoman. She sold a third of her vacuum cleaners to Greenhouse, two more to Red House, and half of the remaining vacuum cleaners to Orange House. If Melanie had five vacuum cleaners left, how many did she start with?

question: 학생 20명으로 구성된 댄스 수업 중 20%는 현대무용, 나머지 25%는 재즈댄스, 나머지는 힙합댄스에 등록했습니다. 힙합댄스에 등록한 학생의 비율은 몇 퍼센트입니까?
translated_en: In a dance class of 20 students, 20% are enrolled in modern dance, 25% in jazz dance, and the rest in hip-hop dance. What percentage of students are enrolled in hip-hop dance?

question: 판매자는 2가지 구매 계획($5,000 상당의 보석 또는 $8,000 상당의 전자 기기) 중에서 구매를 선택하려고 합니다. 그의 재정 고문은 같은 달에 보석 시장이 2.5% 상승하고 전자 기기 시장은 1.2% 상승할 것이라고 추측합니다. 상인이 선택을 하여 이번 달 말에 이익을 극대화하고자 한다면, 이는 얼마나 많은 이익을 얻게 될까요?
translated_en: A merchant wants to choose between two purchase plans: $5,000 worth of jewelry or $8,000 worth of electronics. His financial advisor predicts that the jewelry market will rise 2.5% and the electronics market will rise 1.2% in the same month. If the merchant chooses this option to maximize his profit at the end of the month, how much profit will he make?

question: 두 대의 열차가 동시에 산라파엘을 출발합니다. 그들은 둘 다 80마일을 여행하면서 서쪽으로 여행을 시작합니다. 다음날 그들은 북쪽으로 150마일을 여행합니다. 이틀 동안 각 열차의 이동 거리는 얼마나 됩니까?
translated_en: Two trains leave San Rafael at the same time. They both begin their journey westward, traveling 80 miles. The next day, they travel 150 miles northward. How far will each train travel in two days?

question: 질은 가르치는 일로 시간당 20달러, 치어리더 코치로 일하는 일로 30달러를 받습니다. 만약 그녀가 1년에 50주, 교사로 주 35시간, 코치로 주 15시간 일한다면 그녀의 연봉은 얼마일까요?
translated_en: Jill earns $20 per hour teaching and $30 per hour working as a cheerleading coach. If she works 50 weeks a year, 35 hours per week as a teacher and 15 hours per week as a coach, what will her annual salary be?

question: Claire는 매일 아침 아침 식사로 계란 3개를 만드는 오믈렛을 만듭니다. 4주 동안 계란을 몇십개 먹나요?
translated_en: Claire makes a three-egg omelet for breakfast every morning. How many eggs does she eat in four weeks?

question: 마리사는 12마일 트레일을 하이킹하고 있습니다. 그녀는 처음 4마일을 걷는 데 1시간이 걸렸고, 다음 2마일을 걷는 데 또 한 시간이 걸렸습니다. 그녀가 평균 속도를 시속 4마일로 설정하려면 남은 거리를 걷는 데 필요한 속도(시속 마일)는 얼마입니까?
translated_en: Marisa is hiking a 12-mile trail. It took her an hour to walk the first four miles, and another hour to walk the next two miles. If she averages 4 miles per hour, what pace (in miles per hour) does she need to walk the remaining distance?

question: 저는 3분의 2가 물로 구성된 오렌지 음료 10리터를 가지고 있으며, 이를 5분의 3이 물로 구성된 파인애플 음료 15리터에 추가하고 싶습니다. 그런데 부으면 오렌지 음료 1리터가 쏟아집니다. 나머지 24리터에는 물이 얼마나 들어있나요?
translated_en: I have 10 liters of orange juice, which is two-thirds water, and I want to add it to 15 liters of pineapple juice, which is three-fifths water. However, when I pour it, 1 liter of orange juice spills. How much water is in the remaining 24 liters?

question: 레이몬드와 사만다는 사촌이다. 레이몬드는 사만다보다 6년 먼저 태어났습니다. Raymond는 23세에 아들을 낳았습니다. Samantha가 현재 31세라면 Raymond의 아들은 몇 년 전에 태어났습니까?
translated_en: Raymond and Samantha are cousins. Raymond was born six years before Samantha. Raymond had his son when he was 23. If Samantha is currently 31, how many years ago was Raymond's son born?

question: Billy는 DVD를 판매합니다. 화요일에는 8명의 고객이 있습니다. 그의 처음 3명의 고객은 각각 DVD 한 장을 구입합니다. 그의 다음 고객 2명은 각각 DVD 2장을 구매합니다. 그의 마지막 고객 3명은 DVD를 전혀 구매하지 않습니다. 화요일에 Billy는 DVD를 몇 장 팔았나요?
translated_en: Billy sells DVDs. He has eight customers on Tuesday. His first three customers each buy one DVD. His next two customers each buy two DVDs. His last three customers don't buy any DVDs. How many DVDs did Billy sell on Tuesday?

question: 양초는 불이 붙을 때마다 1시간마다 2cm씩 녹습니다. 오후 1시부터 5시까지 촛불을 켜고 나면 촛불은 몇cm 더 짧아질까요?
translated_en: A candle melts 2 centimeters per hour while it's lit. How many centimeters shorter will the candle be after it's lit from 1 p.m. to 5 p.m.?

question: 카일은 작년 베스트셀러 책을 19.50달러에 샀습니다. 정가에서 25% 할인된 가격입니다. 책의 원래 가격은 얼마였나요?
translated_en: Kyle bought last year's best-selling book for $19.50, a 25% discount from the regular price. What was the original price of the book?

question: Marie는 $12의 닭고기 식사 1개, 개당 $3의 우유 5팩, 개당 $1.50의 사과 4개, 피자 몇 상자를 주문했습니다. Marie는 총 50달러를 지불했습니다. 각 상자의 가격이 $8.50라면 Marie는 몇 상자의 피자를 주문했습니까?
translated_en: Marie ordered a $12 chicken meal, five cartons of milk for $3 each, four apples for $1.50 each, and several boxes of pizza. Marie paid a total of $50. If each box costs $8.50, how many boxes of pizza did Marie order?

question: 미슈카는 반바지 3켤레, 바지 3켤레, 신발 3켤레를 샀습니다. 반바지 한 벌의 가격은 $16.50입니다. 바지 한 켤레의 가격은 22.50달러이고 신발 한 켤레의 가격은 42달러입니다. Mishka는 모든 의류 품목에 몇 달러를 썼습니까?
translated_en: Mishka bought three pairs of shorts, three pairs of pants, and three pairs of shoes. One pair of shorts cost $16.50. One pair of pants cost $22.50. One pair of shoes cost $42. How much did Mishka spend on all the clothing items?

question: 신시아는 매일 밤 아이스크림 한 컵을 먹습니다. 그녀는 상자당 $4.00의 비용으로 상자당 15인분의 아이스크림이 들어 있는 아이스크림 상자를 구입합니다. 60일 후에 그녀는 아이스크림에 얼마를 쓸 것인가?
translated_en: Cynthia eats a cup of ice cream every night. She buys boxes of ice cream, each containing 15 servings, at a cost of $4.00. How much will she spend on ice cream in 60 days?

question: Henry는 60마일의 자전거 여행 동안 두 번 정차했습니다. 그는 20마일 후에 처음으로 멈췄습니다. 그의 두 번째 정류장은 여행이 끝나기 15마일 전이었습니다. 그는 첫 번째 정류장과 두 번째 정류장 사이를 몇 마일이나 이동했습니까?
translated_en: Henry stopped twice during his 60-mile bike ride. He stopped for the first time after 20 miles. His second stop was 15 miles before the end of the trip. How many miles did he travel between the first and second stops?

question: 글로리아는 신발 쇼핑을 하다가 자신의 신발 예산에 맞는 부츠를 발견했습니다. 그러나 그녀는 부츠와 부츠보다 5달러 더 저렴한 하이힐 두 켤레 중에서 하나를 선택해야 합니다. 힐 한 켤레의 가격이 33달러이고 다른 한 켤레의 가격이 두 배라면 부츠는 몇 달러입니까?
